name: Sun Cleric: Leap of the Valkyrie already leaps and slows, and rank 2 already shortens Sun Stride (#1561)
contract: Rank 1 (300320) is a passive Proc Trigger Spell (aura 42) aura with ProcFlags 0, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs never generates a proc entry for it and the aura itself never fires. But Valkyrie Spear (800656, the base ability the tooltip names) already carries a native, unconditional SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL (Effect index 1 = 64) triggering 805582 on every cast, regardless of any learned talent; 805582 itself is SPELL_EFFECT_JUMP_DEST (leap to target) plus an APPLY_AURA SPELL_AURA_MOD_DECREASE_SPEED (BasePoints -81, DieSides 1, resolving to -80 per SpellEffectInfo::CalcBaseValue's -1 convention) for the DurationIndex-39 window: exactly 'leap to your target and slow their movement speed by 80% for 2 sec'. The talent's own broken proc is therefore redundant, not blocking. Rank 2 (301295) is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107), MiscValue 11 = SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, EffectSpellClassMask word 3 = 0x800000; Sun Stride (680700) carries that same bit in its own SpellFamilyFlags word 3, so SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod's generic family-33 path (falls through the family-33 named-root switch, which does not list 301295, to the plain flag96 AND) admits it without any extra routing. BasePoints -4001 resolves to -4000, matching 'Reduces the cooldown of Sun Stride by 4 sec' on a 24000ms RecoveryTime. Native only, no server code needed for either rank. Spell::EffectJumpDest resolves a fixed destination near the target (SpellEffectInfo TARGET_DEST-style implicit target), so the post-talent recast uses a second, untouched dummy at the same starting range: recasting on the already-approached first dummy would measure near-zero further movement (the caster is already standing at the leap's destination), proving nothing about whether the talent breaks the leap.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Base ability fixture, not the audited talent
Cast Valkyrie Spear without ever learning 300320
Base ability already leaps the caster to melee range
Base ability already applies the 80% slow (805582) with no talent learned
Let the 2 sec slow expire before the repeat check
Learn the (broken but harmless) rank 1 talent
Distance to a fresh, untouched dummy at the same starting range
Re-cast on the fresh dummy with the talent learned: identical behavior, no duplication
Sun Stride cooldown modifier before rank 2
Rank 2: Reduces the cooldown of Sun Stride by 4 sec
Sun Stride's cooldown modifier drops by 4000ms
